## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The invitation validator should adopt the twelve-character minimum because it still accepts passwords below the new requirement.

## Changes
The pull request raises the signup and reset password minimum from eight to twelve characters and updates their boundary tests.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/signup.py:1 — correctness — Apply the twelve-character minimum to invitations — An invitation password of `xxxxxxxx` still passes validation despite the new twelve-character requirement. Your change leaves `app/invite.py:1` at eight; `tests/test_invite.py:8` explicitly expects that behavior. — Callers using invitation validation can accept passwords that violate the policy enforced during signup and reset. — Fix: Raise the invitation minimum and update `test_password_boundaries` in `tests/test_invite.py`.
